# Security policy

Next Fold is a public demo site. Its latest release on `main` is the only supported version.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/marcop135/nextfold/security/advisories/new) on this repository, or the contact form at [marcopontili.com/contact](https://marcopontili.com/contact). Do not open a public issue.

Include the URL or file, what an attacker could do, and steps to reproduce.

## Scope

In scope: <https://nextfold.marcopontili.com>, its Markdown routes, `/api/*`, and this repository's code and workflows. The embedded Sanity Studio and Sanity's own API belong to [Sanity](https://www.sanity.io/security); Vercel hosting belongs to [Vercel](https://vercel.com/security).
